one_liner: Forest app generates customizable tree distributions (circle or rectangle) with clustering, size variation, and UI controls for Hyperfy V2 worlds.
primary_use_case: Procedurally generate and place large numbers of trees in a Hyperfy V2 world, allowing designers to customize count, shape, clustering, and size via UI.
preview_recommendation: Use the provided MP4 preview to verify visual quality and performance of the generated forest before deploying.
